يقتنيان (form VIII)
# يَقْتَنِيَانِ (yaqtaniyāni) /jaq.ta.ni.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِقْتَنَى (iqtanā)
# يُقْتَنَيَانِ (yuqtanayāni) /juq.ta.na.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَنَى (iqtanā)
